rationale: The agent executed return actions without first confirming with the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. There is no clear authentication step beyond looking up by email; no verification (e.g., OTP or equivalent) is shown prior to acting. The agent did not clarify which items were “not associated with gaming” nor verify exclusions (keyboard and mouse) before proceeding. It also chose mixed refund methods without confirming the user’s preference per order. Finally, the agent did not provide a clear final summary of actions or outcomes—only a goodbye. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
